product_family: Braze Customer Engagement Platform: a cloud-based SaaS platform with cross-channel messaging, AI-powered journey orchestration, and data unification. Includes BrazeAI (decisioning & agents), Braze Data Platform, and HIPAA-compliant offerings.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Braze successfully completed its SOC 2 Type 2 audit for Security and Availability, audit period July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025, performed by Schellman & Company, LLC

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 certification as of December 18, 2018, renewed as of August 29, 2025. Expires December 15, 2027

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Braze enters into EU Standard Contractual Clauses with customers, self-certifies to EU-US and Swiss-US Data Privacy Frameworks and UK Extension. Provides GDPR-compliant data handling and DPA

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Braze operates a HIPAA-compliant cluster that meets Security and Privacy rules of HIPAA 1996. Separate databases, servers, firewall rules, and virtual networks isolate protected health information. Signs Business Associate Agreements

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: Braze supports CCPA compliance through tools enabling data access requests, erasure, and rectification

certifications.name: TISAX Assessment Level 3 (AL3)
certifications.proof_quote: Successfully achieved TISAX Assessment Level 3 (AL3) with certifications across EU-GDPR data protection, high availability, and confidentiality standards

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of PCI DSS certification; Braze mentions TLS 1.2+ compliance for REST APIs per PCI Council requirements but does not claim PCI DSS certification

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on Braze's security qualifications or trust center pages

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of ISO 27017 (cloud security) certification on public Braze domain

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of ISO 27018 (cloud personal data protection) certification on public Braze domain

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of ISO 42001 (AI management systems) certification in 2025 ESG report or security qualifications pages

privacy.ai_training_note: Braze does not use customer data to train public AI models. All AI processing happens in secure, first-party data environments where customer information remains protected. Data is not shared externally for training purposes.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region: US (Virginia + 7 additional instances), EU (Frankfurt + Ireland backup), Australia, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea. Customers can select US or EU hosting. Braze will not transfer personal data from the country where it is originally stored.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2+ required; older TLS versions (1.0, 1.1) deprecated per PCI DSS Council requirements

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Industry-standard encryption for data at rest. API keys and passwords additionally encrypted

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Regular third-party penetration testing and bug bounty program to identify vulnerabilities

security.name: HIPAA cluster isolation
security.value: Dedicated HIPAA-compliant cluster with separate databases, servers, firewall rules, and virtual networks. Two-factor authorization, IP whitelisting, password expiration policies

security.name: Data Privacy Framework
security.value: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, UK Extension to EU-U.S. DPF, Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework for lawful international transfers

security.name: Standard Contractual Clauses
security.value: Offers EU Standard Contractual Clauses for international data transfers with customers requiring them

security.name: Data Processing Addendum
security.value: Available in English and Japanese; covers processor responsibilities and data handling obligations

security.name: Subprocessor list
security.value: Maintains and publishes list of third-party data handlers for transparency

products.name: Braze Customer Engagement Platform
products.data_scope: Cross-channel marketing data (customer profiles, engagement history, behavioral data from email, SMS, mobile, web channels)
products.notes: Core product; all core certifications apply

products.name: BrazeAI
products.data_scope: Uses customer behavioral data for decisioning and predictive features; processing occurs in first-party secure environments without external training
products.notes: Does not train on customer data for public models

products.name: Braze Data Platform
products.data_scope: Unifies customer data from multiple sources for activation in marketing campaigns
products.notes: Supports first-party data activation; GDPR and CCPA compliant

products.name: HIPAA-compliant Braze
products.data_scope: Protected health information (PHI) in dedicated HIPAA cluster
products.notes: Separate infrastructure; signs BAAs; ideal for healthcare, financial services, and regulated industries

products.name: BrazeAI Agents
products.data_scope: Customer engagement data for AI-driven autonomous agent decision-making
products.notes: Operates within first-party secure environments; no external data sharing

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription; usage-based pricing with multiple tiers (flexible pricing depending on customer scale)
compare.data_residency: Cloud-only SaaS; multi-region options (US, EU, APAC) but no on-premise or self-hosted deployment option

flags: ISO 27017 and ISO 27018 (cloud-specific standards) not held; vendor is enterprise cloud SaaS but these certifications are not common across the industry and not required for core compliance posture
FedRAMP not held; relevant only for US federal government customers; not a gap for commercial customer base
ISO 42001 (AI governance) not held: new standard (2024+) and not yet widespread; Braze does maintain governance controls but lacks formal AI certification
No evidence of self-hosted or on-premise deployment options: cloud-only SaaS model; customers cannot self-host
